notes.content:
ALICE Ver.0.1.0 – First New Character Release: Koraku Shines Bright!

【Koraku Officially Joins the Battle!】
※ The long-awaited Koraku has finally arrived after a long delay. Although the character still has some missing elements and a few unknown bugs remain, we promise to provide frequent updates over the next 1–2 months to polish Koraku to perfection.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43535171/8d81f529a01dcd569ba2376bfacf2e3ffa4ead19.gif[/img]
【Skills】
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43535171/c35ff11c26c7fa72e45cac45cfe4d53608d4e7ee.gif[/img]
• Primary Attack - Guren Greatsword
        - Tap: Swing the greatsword forward, dealing 166% Damage

	- Hold: Enter a charging state to unleash [Guren Form I: Charged Slash]
	- Can be charged up to 3 stages, each stage increasing range and damage:
		* Stage I: Vertical Slash — 207.5% Damage
		* Stage II: Horizontal Slash — 332% Damage (+30% Range)
		* Stage III: Powerful Vertical Slash — 830% Damage (+30% Range)

	- While charging, Movement Speed is reduced by 30%
	- Each stage requires approximately 1 seconds (affected by Attack Speed)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43535171/c65ef9eef8693034c95286d2da23ef08d694770b.gif[/img]
• Secondary Attack - Battle Roar
	- Release a battle cry, dealing 10 Unstable damage to all enemies within range
	- Each battle cry increases All Attribute by 3%
	- This effect stacks, up to 5 stacks

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43535171/d75403bd26e3f4e38e5288a423bedb557e3fb95f.gif[/img]
• Primary Skill - Adaptive Gear
	- Recast the last used skill

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43535171/2fa4ee79ddb9e6dbdee32701a3656b00162fffd0.gif[/img]
• Ultimate Skill - Ultra-Heavy Greatsword
	- Enhances the next [Guren Skill]:
		* Attack Range increased by 100%
		* Charge Time reduced by 30%
		* Damage increased to 200%

	- If possessing at least 10 stacks of [Guren Spirit], [Guren Form IX: Greatsword Descent] can be used again:
		* After charging, deals 500% Damage to a wide area in front, guaranteed Critical Hit
		* For each stack above 10, Damage is increased by an additional 50%
		* Consumes all [Guren Spirit] upon use

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43535171/625e3f71afc75bb09412367c14c66540024dfff7.gif[/img]
• Special Skill - Fox Dash
	- Tap: Quickly dash forward (no damage)

	- Hold: Enter a charging state to unleash [Fox Charge]
		* Can be charged up to 3 seconds
		* The longer the charge, the faster the dash and the higher the damage (100% to 300%)
		* Movement Speed reduced by 30% while charging
		* [Fox Charge] will immediately stop upon colliding with an enemy

• Passive - Battle Gear
	* Gain 5% Barrier each time you hit an enemy  
	* Deal 25% increased damage to enemies affected by Unstable
	* Can climb walls up to 85 degrees
	* Jumping can be charged by holding the button. A fully charged jump leaps higher and deals 50% damage to nearby enemies

• Passive - Guren Spirit
	- By casting specific [Guren Skill], Koraku gradually accumulates [Guren Spirit]
	- Each stack of [Guren Spirit] grants +1% Critical Chance, up to 20 stacks

	- Gain 1 stack of [Guren Spirit] upon successfully using:
		* [Guren Form I: Charged Slash]
		* [Guren Form II: Cyclone]
		* [Guren Form III: Vortex]

	- [Guren Spirit] can be consumed to use special skill:
		* With at least 10 stacks, [Guren Form IX: Greatsword Descent] can be used

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43535171/3c43fcab387698631c8e8b4c42018d6790407adf.gif[/img]
• Combo - Guren Form II: Cyclone
	- Koraku transforms into a cyclone, slashing forward rapidly
	- Deals 3–6 hits depending on [Fox Charge] charge stage, each hit dealing 90%–180% Damage based on [Guren Form I: Charged Slash] charge stage

	- If both [Guren Form I: Charged Slash] and [Fox Charge] are fully charged, [Guren Form II EX: Maelstrom] is unleashed, greatly increasing hit count and spin speed, dealing 12 total hits at 125% Damage each

	※ Can be triggered with the following inputs:
		1. [Guren Form I: Charged Slash] → [Fox Charge] = Dash forward activation (ignores unit collision while dashing)
		2. [Fox Charge] → [Guren Form I: Charged Slash] = Stationary activation (can still be triggered within a short window after [Fox Charge] hits)

	※ Triggers on-hit effects of [Guren Greatsword]
	※ [Guren Form II EX: Maelstrom] is the empowered form of this skill and is treated as the same skill

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43535171/749ba95445e9f6cfc45951a954157865d6fcef5d.gif[/img]
• Combo - Guren Form III: Vortex
	- Koraku quickly rolls forward and slashes enemies repeatedly in midair, each hit dealing 50% Damage.  

	- Upon landing, unleashes [Guren Form III: Vortex Breaker], dealing 175%–400% Damage depending on [Guren Form I: Charged Slash] charge stage.  
	- Damage and attack range further increase based on landing speed, up to 6x Damage and 3x Range.  

	※ Can be triggered with the following inputs:
		1. [Guren Form I: Charged Slash] → Charged Jump = Upward activation
		2. Charged Jump → [Guren Form I: Charged Slash] = Upward activation
		3. While airborne → [Guren Form I: Charged Slash] = Stationary activation
		4. [Guren Form III: Vortex] → [Fox Charge] = Dash forward while maintaining [Guren Form III: Vortex] state  
	※ Triggers on-hit effects of [Guren Greatsword].

notes.title: Development Progress
notes.content:
[quote][p]Sorry for the frequent updates!
We've had a lot of progress and reflections lately that we wanted to share, along with some development updates.
Don't worry—there’s nothing disappointing to announce.[/p][/quote][h2]💰 Summer Sale and Development Progress[/h2][p]Thanks to the success of the Summer Sale, we’ve had a decent boost in revenue, allowing us to reasonably expand our outsourcing team to accelerate development.
We won’t overextend—our budget and planning are under control.[/p][p]We owe this to your support.
Thank you for standing by us even during Early Access.
We’ll continue to offer exclusive rewards for EA supporters.[/p][p]We’ve also been reflecting on players who bought the "expensive version" of the game before its permanent price drop.
While we originally intended to offer extra rewards to these early buyers, many of you have expressed that you’d rather see all players treated equally—regardless of whether they were EA players or paid full price at launch.
This is an admirable stance, and while we understand the desire to avoid FOMO, we still worry whether we’ve done our moral duty if we don’t offer something to those who paid more.[/p][p]If Steam allowed easy partial refunds based on price differences, we would have done it without hesitation.
But since that’s not feasible, we chose to offer in-game rewards (like virtual items) instead.
We’d love to hear your thoughts and feedback on this approach. Thank you all once again.[/p][h2]🐰 Upcoming Costumes[/h2][p]The next costume theme will be Bunny Girls!
We plan to release some lighter summer outfits before autumn, and one of them will be available as a free reward.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43535171/3b0089ff7af9c6459c3018b33056534c1b37fdaa.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43535171/27c65a47de713e5f8aca52831b693f5d92852b6e.jpg"][/img][/p][h2]👙 On Lea’s Swimsuit[/h2][p]Lea’s swimsuit is currently going through its final adjustments.
Before and after submitting the page for review, we asked Steam staff several times about specific details—whether the original version was allowed, whether this revised one was acceptable—but received no reply.
[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3818470/EndlessAlice_Lea_Swimsuit/?curator_clanid=43535171"][/dynamiclink] Eventually, the page was approved without any response.[/p][p]To be safe, we asked again if we could get a definitive confirmation.
Their reply: if we’re uncertain, we probably shouldn’t use it.[/p][p]We consulted with some veteran H-game developers, and they told us that Valve doesn’t really have a consistent standard—so it’s better to be conservative.
We’re trying to find a balance. You can see the current version in the image attached.
We believe it’s safe and should not cause any issues.[/p][p]We don’t blame the platform.
We understand it could be pressure from payment processors.
We suspect these services don’t provide clear review guidelines, which causes this kind of ambiguity.
Hopefully, developers will have more creative freedom in the future.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43535171/8a84c0194d8d0a71bb176bdb5cc6db64af808e4a.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43535171/bc89139967ed5010149d18c6c1700b7654ef660d.png"][/img][/p][h2]🎀 On Shimiao’s Twin-Tail Hairstyle[/h2][p]This hairstyle is priced higher than usual.
As we've mentioned, our game doesn’t use a paper-doll system.
That means the default hairstyle and the twin-tails have very different bone structures, which required us to rework many animations.[/p][p]In other words, it took almost twice as much time to produce.
So we set a higher price point that’s still reasonable and optional for those who want to support us.
We also plan to add extra perks to this hairstyle to increase its value.
However, we can’t promise what those will be just yet—please consider this before purchasing!

[/p][p][b]Why We Don't Use a Paper-Doll System?[/b][/p][p]So why don’t we implement a paper-doll system where you can mix and match tops, bottoms, and accessories?[/p][p]Because if we did, creating one character could take 3 to 10 times longer than it does now.
While I personally love creating wacky fashion combos, it’s just not realistic for us at this stage.
But who knows—maybe one day we’ll challenge ourselves to do it![/p][h2]🦊 On Koraku’s Delay and Launch Timing[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43535171/9639c9c921949c76535f14e3e57fab22fa1a5e50.jpg"][/img][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://youtu.be/g9Pi1Di-9GI"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]Koraku is possibly the hardest character we’ve had to design so far.[/p][p]Our game has a fast pace, but Koraku—being designed around a heavy greatsword—was originally slower and more deliberate.
This didn’t feel good, so we iterated multiple times.[/p][p]Meanwhile, the engineer working on her was frequently pulled off to fix other bugs, came back to tweak her, then left again—it was back and forth for weeks, making it hard to pin down a final release date. We’d love your ideas on how to improve her![/p][h3]Please keep these in mind when offering suggestions:[/h3][list][*][p]Our game places a strong emphasis on three-dimensional depth in its gameplay.[/p][p]Many traditional action games—even some that don’t include jumping and only use dashing—may not be suitable as direct references for our design.[/p][/*][*][p]Our characters have separated upper/lower body systems—players can move while attacking, and we want to keep it that way.
We did try disabling attack movement for her, but with the game’s fast pace, it felt terrible and players just got hit constantly.[/p][/*][/list][p]If we ignore the "fun" factor for a second—Koraku is technically almost complete.
We just need to fix a few bugs, adjust some VFX, and finish the missing sound effects.[/p][p]We don’t have an in-house sound designer, so we’re waiting for our outsourced partner’s schedule.
That’s why Koraku keeps getting delayed—her gameplay mechanics are tough to tune, and we’ve had resource issues along the way.[/p][p]We really hope she can release before the end of July.
Sorry again for the long wait![/p][h2]⚔️ Next Characters[/h2][p]Melee characters are a core feature we want to showcase.
But they require so much more polish—skills, animations, and gameplay must all work together.[/p][p]If a skill isn’t fun, we often have to remake the entire animation, whereas ranged characters can reuse basic actions like aiming or throwing and focus more on projectile logic.[/p][p]After Koraku, we plan to release around two new ranged characters.
During this time, we’ll also study ways to reduce the production cost of melee characters, so we can hopefully make more of them in the future—they’re just so cool and expressive!

notes.title: Gratitude for players’ enthusiastic support.
notes.content: [p][b]We are pleased to offer the Lea outfit free of charge.[/b] Although the Lea Swimsuit outfit has already passed the store-page review, we plan to use it as a purchase reward exclusively for our Early Access players. In addition, we will continue to provide further rewards to Early Access participants and, most importantly, to those who supported us at launch by purchasing the higher-tier edition.[/p][p]Furthermore, our recent Summer Sale generated stronger revenue compared to the previous event, which has significantly relieved our financial pressure. We are confident that the game will continue to improve and achieve even greater success moving forward.[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3818470/EndlessAlice_Lea_Swimsuit/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p][p][b]Custom Skins unlocked upon meeting specific gameplay conditions.[/b] We initially planned to offer Custom Skins that players could unlock by meeting specific in-game conditions or achievements; however, due to our heavy workload, we’ve temporarily set aside these features that are not directly related to core gameplay. We expect to complete them in the near future.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43535171/d40a465d1ffc54daea81cfd49703ff44be9e2644.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43535171/19d7e869e9c7326e4049871ddb58630e1338799f.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43535171/2f02a70ffd4839a29049f7f5bc265e4c5a57e4ee.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Since announcing the DLC,[/b] we have noticed a significant drop in player numbers in certain regions. I’d like to address some of the concerns and possible reasons I’ve heard.[/p][p]First, some players worry that releasing cosmetic DLC during Early Access will delay core development and harm player interests. Please let me assure you that our 3D team’s capacity and output are more than sufficient. As you can see in the in-game compendium and the occasional model previews on our Discord, many enemy unit models are already complete. While modeling itself is straightforward, animating, rigging, implementing gameplay functions, adjusting skills, fixing bugs, balancing stats, and extensive playtesting are what truly demand time. With our current staffing, the 3D pipeline is well ahead of schedule. However, we still need to keep our artists and developers busy, so we assign cosmetic DLC tasks that do not impact the main development timeline. Rest assured, we are not prioritizing quick profits over game polishing or creating new content.[/p][p][b]We are an independent studio with no external investors or complex ownership structures; every team member is a veteran player who understands what you like and dislike.[/b] All our decisions are carefully measured. By lowering the base game price and offering optional cosmetic DLC that does [b]not[/b] affect character abilities, we estimate only about 5–8% of players will purchase it. There is no pay-to-win scenario, and the additional revenue—especially outside of seasonal sales—directly supports our ongoing development. We believe that releasing cosmetic DLC in Early Access is a win-win for our studio, for players, and for the Steam platform, allowing us to move forward more steadily. We hope you will understand our approach.[/p][p]That said, the decline in player numbers may have other causes. We welcome open discussions on both Steam and Discord so that we can gain a more comprehensive understanding of community feedback across different regions—whether about the DLC or any aspect of development.[/p][p]Since launch, [b]Japanese players have formed the largest player segment—35% of our user base[/b]—which surprised us given global Steam demographics and Japan’s console-oriented gaming habits. After our price reduction, purchases from Japan rose to over 45%. We are sincerely grateful for your support and apologize that the Japanese localization isn’t yet perfect. We will continue improving it to provide you with a better experience and hope you will grow with us.[/p][p][b]We know the game still has shortcomings[/b]—both in gameplay and bugs—and we work daily to fix them. Many gameplay issues you’ve pointed out are already under internal discussion and resolution. Some bugs stem from our agile development approach during the demo phase and require refactoring; virtually all non-engine issues can be fixed, and engine-related bugs will improve as Unreal Engine updates. Please give us time—every patch will reduce flaws and enhance your experience.[/p][p]Thank you for reading and for your continued optimism. Although we currently carry significant debt, we face each day with confidence in this game’s potential, bolstered by the best community in the world. We are deeply grateful for your support.[/p]

notes.title: [Major Announcement] Price Reduction & Compensation Notice - 2025/06/20
notes.content: [p]We are permanently lowering the base price of the game from USD 9.99 to USD 7.99. This is not a temporary sale but a permanent adjustment to our base pricing. Other regions price adjustments will apply accordingly.[/p][p]To compensate those who purchased at the higher price, we will grant two swimsuit costumes—Shibako and Shimiao—to affected players. We regret having to make this decision; the reasons are outlined below. [/p][p]Currently, Endless Alice generates approximately USD 100 in daily revenue. Upon review, we believe this is due to a lack of sufficient gameplay depth and remaining bugs. We are working tirelessly every day to improve the experience, and long-time players should have noticed significant enhancements since launch. Our monthly personnel costs range between USD 30,000 and USD 50,000, with a baseline expenditure of USD 35,000; additional costs depend on outsourcing. To manage expenses, we have temporarily suspended some 3D/2D and animation art outsourcing, so art production will progress more slowly. We will resume full production speed once our financial situation improves.[/p][p]If performance does not improve following the price reduction, we will adopt a more conservative update strategy: significantly reduce new content development, further minimize in-game bugs, and polish existing content before ending Early Access and releasing version 1.0. Reportedly, the Full Release receives 3–4× the organic exposure on Steam compared to Early Access. We hope to avoid this scenario and aim to balance new content creation with ongoing debugging to keep the game feeling fresh.[/p][p]Rest assured, the game will not be abandoned. In the worst-case scenario, a three-person team can continue development and maintenance (albeit at a slower pace). We are still well above that threshold and remain fully committed to this project. Many new features are already in planning and production. We apologize for not publishing a Roadmap: our development frequently falls behind schedule, and committing to dates could lead to repeated delays. The game has undergone extensive debugging; once we can better manage our production timeline, we will publish the Roadmap.[/p][p] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43535171/0be8b759c2cb9ff776c80dede525a438debec075.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43535171/2fa48a4699ecb64a8b6809ff95928e184441aadb.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]We originally planned to release other characters’ swimsuit costumes simultaneously, but Lea’s swimsuit has not yet passed review. We expect to release Lea’s costume next week, once approved. Since Shibako’s and Shimiao’s swimsuits are compensation, they will be released early. [/p][p]Below are preview images of the new swimsuits—we hope you enjoy them and consider purchasing to support development. More skins are in the pipeline, including bunny girl, school uniform, gym suit, cheerleader, maid outfit, festive costumes, and more. Stay tuned![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43535171/4105e01a061ee988df8b532998cffa16938f083d.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43535171/59fc28ade38b60d3391403ed97e34d71cbd28389.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]Rare Shimiao Twin-Tail Variant[/b][/p][p]Without a paper-doll system, radically different hairstyles or outfits require substantial additional effort. For example, converting Shimiao’s default long hair to twin-tails necessitated extensive rigging and animation adjustments. Although initially experimental, the result was so appealing we felt compelled to release it. Since such drastic variants won’t be common, this premium skin is priced higher; please consider your purchase accordingly. This variant will also be used as an event reward! [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43535171/fe6dd4e3a2663820d2e72847d2b82813de355b49.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43535171/47e5b3fcdd8b71eae1c86645f6c3c72bad6516a7.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]Shibako Swimsuit Set[/b] In a future update, the shirt will be removable.  [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43535171/c39b1085c586274f96ddccef3151ce13caead983.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]We are an independent development team, self-funded through the sale of our own assets and free from publisher or investor interference. Although this is our first time creating a game, we’re committed to engaging directly with players and maintaining open dialogue. We hope to earn even greater support from the community, and we sincerely thank everyone who has accompanied us on this journey.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][b]Additional Notes[/b] To correctly compensate players who bought at the old price, we must publish a new game build and pass Steam's review. This process depends on Steam's schedule and may not align perfectly with our announcement. We have researched this compensation method extensively—if you know a better approach, please let us know. Thank you for your understanding and support![/p]

notes.title: 2025/02/08 Multiple Updates and a New Public Beta Test Branch
notes.content:
Due to limited internal resources, we are unable to fully test every new release before deployment. To address this, we have decided to open a Beta branch that contains updates that have not undergone full testing. We hope the community can help us test this version. If there are no major issues, the updates will be merged into the stable (relatively stable) version. Additionally, this Beta branch may include more experimental and ambitious features. If the player community finds some of these experiments interesting, they may be officially implemented in future releases.

How to Enable the Beta Version:
1. Go to your Library and find the game.
2. Right-click on the game -> Properties.
3. Navigate to the Betas tab and select "alice_beta - public beta test".
4. Once downloaded, the game will run in Beta mode.

Beta Version Features:
- Periodic data wipes.
- 30,000 Alice Coins available.
- Unlock all items.
- Regular updates and bug fixes, which will be released to the stable version after testing.
- Experimental content and features.


The game is still in early development, with dozens to nearly a hundred changes made daily. There may be oversights that could lead to more issues, and we sincerely appreciate the community’s support in helping us improve the game. Thank you all for your assistance!

notes.title: Endless Alice：G-EIGHT's latest post-exhibition demo version continues to be open
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43535171/4e7c834a968b7c6bd7ec050184e73900b8320e84.jpg[/img]
[h3][b]The highly anticipated new update for "Endless Alice" has arrived! In response to the enthusiastic reception at the 2023 G-EIGHT Gaming Expo, the brand-new demo is now available for open play on Steam, introducing a series of exciting new elements![/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43535171/9ea46f1bbff02ac848fc50e915b0c1432c80b35a.jpg[/img]

[h2][b]Brand New Boss Battles Unleashed[/b][/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43535171/e28f944003da0ca6d733478dcee6892eac5ed505.png[/img]
[b]Players can look forward to more challenging boss battles in the latest version of Endless Alice. Not only has the difficulty level been raised, but it will also bring unprecedented combat experiences, testing players' skills and strategic thinking.[/b]

[h2][b]New Characters "Lea" and "TakeHime" Debut[/b][/h2]

[h3][b]Lea[/b][/h3]

[b]A ranged character using a bow in combat, Lea excels at deploying floating cannons for long-range output, demonstrating proficiency in using agile floating cannons and precise arrow attacks.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43535171/c7f0bd13319d052d53aa8bb55fa36679a86ecc8f.png[/img]

[h3][b]TakeHime[/b][/h3]

[b]A master of swordplay from the Eastern lands, TakeHime moves gracefully between illusions, silently leading targets to their demise. She is a well-balanced melee expert in both offense and defense.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43535171/665d52139fdcc24d0c0738abe4f3a466ef1737bf.png[/img]

[h2][b]New System: Fate Altar[/b][/h2]

[b]The carefully designed Altar of Fate provides more strategic choices, offering players a richer gameplay experience![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43535171/3a07680c64feec35d56eebe41a6766d0f1f2b855.png[/img]

[h2][b]Improved Performance - Play with Ease on Low-End PCs[/b][/h2]

[b]This update includes optimizations for performance, making the game more friendly to lower-end computers. Now, more players can enjoy a smooth gaming experience without worrying about hardware limitations.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43535171/8102f305bf14499430c333c98432b6e0cb7bb1e5.png[/img]

[h2][b]New Diverse Natural Landscapes - Embark on an Adventure[/b][/h2]

[b]The new natural landscapes provide varied scenery, enhancing players' visual enjoyment of the gaming experience.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43535171/184fe60a3ccbc92d24620d93bcbba42176b35c75.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43535171/3b6639ab303fafbc1514bdc1a516f3d26d90cb57.jpg[/img]

[h2][b]First Endless Alice Illustration Contest - Submission Deadline Extended![/b][/h2]

[b]To express gratitude for the extensive support from players, Endless Alice announces an extension for submissions to the Clibo "First Endless Alice Illustration Contest"! Participants now have more opportunities to showcase creativity and win generous prizes.[/b]
